info.name: OHM Backend API
info.description: Detailed collection generated from current Django URLconf, views, serializers, permissions and models. Import the companion local environment. Tenant calls require X-Tenant and tenant-issued JWTs; root/platform calls omit X-Tenant and use platform-admin JWTs. Onboarding approval provisions asynchronously and needs a Celery worker. See request descriptions for access rules and implementation notes.

item.name: 01 - Health and public catalogue
item.description: No authentication. Health is host-level; public plans expose active entries.

request.description: Returns {status, schema}. Does not verify tenant routing.
Public list of active plans. Platform admins also see inactive plans.
Public read of active plan; platform admins may also read inactive plans.
Checks tenant subdomain availability. Query slug is required.

item.name: 02 - Authentication
item.description: For platform/root accounts omit X-Tenant. Tenant accounts must include X-Tenant. JWTs are schema-bound. Login accepts email or phone as username.

request.description: Unified login. Tenant account: include X-Tenant; platform admin: omit it.
Returns 202 with a generic detail regardless of account existence. OTP expires in five minutes; delivery depends on email/SMS configuration.
Use the six digit login OTP.
SimpleJWT token refresh. Rotation is enabled; save returned refresh value when present.
Request a password-reset code. Include X-Tenant for tenant accounts; omit for root.
Consumes one password_reset OTP and changes the password. Django password validators apply.
Requires access token. Blacklists the supplied refresh token; current access JWT remains valid until expiry.

item.name: 03 - Tenant customer registration
item.description: Tenant schema only. Set X-Tenant to an active tenant. Registration assigns CUSTOMER role.

request.description: email/password required; full_name and phone optional. Returns 201 with email.

item.name: 04 - Tenant workspace user management
item.description: Tenant Admin only. Set X-Tenant and use tenant-issued accessToken. Methods supported: GET, POST, PATCH.

query.description: Case-insensitive email or full name search.

request.description: Optional filters role=TENANT_ADMIN|CUSTOMER and q for email/name substring.
Create CUSTOMER or TENANT_ADMIN. Password required; role defaults to CUSTOMER.
Retrieve a tenant user.
Email cannot be changed. Password in updates is ignored. Cannot deactivate yourself or remove the last active Tenant Admin.

item.name: 05 - Provider onboarding
item.description: Public schema submission is open. Current code requires platform admin for every follow-up request; applicant token access described in README is not implemented.

request.description: Accepts JSON, multipart, or form. Required: organization_name, email, contact_phone, slug. requested_plan is active plan ID or null. Saves response id as onboardingId; response itself has id/status only.

body.raw:
{
  "organization_name": "Example Health",
  "email": "owner@example.com",
  "contact_phone": "+15551234567",
  "address": "123 Example Street",
  "branches": [
    {
      "name": "Main Clinic",
      "address": "123 Example Street"
    }
  ],
  "ops_admin_email": "ops@example.com",
  "slug": "example-health",
  "custom_domain": "",
  "wants_custom_website": false,
  "requested_plan": "{{planId}}"
}

request.description: Platform admin only. Optional status filter.

Platform admin only; submitted requests only. Returns 202. Requires a running Celery worker to provision.

item.name: 06 - Platform tenant administration
item.description: Public schema only; platform admin required. List supports status and DRF search filters.

query.description: Search name, schema, contact email, domain.

request.description: Public tenant excluded. ?status=active and ?search=clinic are supported.
Creates schema directly in ACTIVE status; domain optional and primary. Distinct from approval-driven onboarding.
Platform admin only.
Writable fields: name, owner, modules, logo, contact_email, contact_phone, timezone, tags, default_currency.
Only active tenants can be suspended; middleware blocks tenant requests while suspended.
Only suspended tenants can be reactivated.
Destructive. Tenant must be suspended and confirm must exactly match schema_name. Permanently drops schema/data; returns 204.

item.name: 07 - Tenant owner profile and activation
item.description: Owner-only endpoints. Requires tenant-bound token and X-Tenant. Profile accepts JSON, multipart, or form data.

request.description: List tenants owned by caller.
Retrieve one owned tenant.
Editable: name, contact_email, contact_phone, timezone, tags, default_currency, logo. Activation requires name/contact_email/contact_phone/timezone/default_currency.
Owner can activate only a provisioning tenant after required profile fields are complete.

item.name: 08 - Plans and subscriptions
item.description: Plan reads are public; plan writes and subscription CRUD require platform admin.

request.description: Writes use feature_ids; returned representation includes features.
Plan deletion when in use returns 409; deactivate it instead.
Platform admin only; 204 if unused, 409 if referenced by tenants.
Optional filters: tenant, plan, status.
starts_at required; ends_at must be after starts_at. Response includes plan_name.
Platform admin only.
Partial update of subscription fields.
Platform admin only; returns 204.
